say:0:1611115001:0.text: There are traces of sealing magic on the Hypofiends inside the Memory Stars.
say:0:1611115001:0.source_cn: 记忆之星里的魔物身上有封印魔法的痕迹。

say:1:1611115002:0.text: From the memories you've recovered, it seems you originally sealed these Hypofiends inside for teaching and research.
say:1:1611115002:0.source_cn: 从之前找到的记忆推断，过去的你将这些魔物封印在记忆之星...
say:1:1611115002:0.male: From the memories you've recovered, it seems you originally sealed these Hypofiends inside for teaching and research.
say:1:1611115002:0.female: From the memories you've recovered, it seems you originally sealed these Hypofiends inside for teaching and research.

say:3:1611115003:0.text: Merlin, you actually stored monsters inside Memory Stars?!
say:3:1611115003:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，您竟然能将魔物储存在记忆之星里！
say:3:1611115003:0.male: Merlin, you actually stored monsters inside Memory Stars?!
say:3:1611115003:0.female: Merlin, you actually stored monsters inside Memory Stars?!

choice_prompt:4:1611115003.text: Merlin, you actually stored monsters inside Memory Stars?!

choice_prompt:4:1611115003.female: Merlin, you actually stored monsters inside Memory Stars?!

say:5:1611115004:0.text: Amazing... They've been sealed away for so long, but they're still alive!
say:5:1611115004:0.source_cn: 果然……真厉害，这些魔物被封印了这么久，居然还活着！
say:5:1611115004:0.male: Amazing... They've been sealed away for so long, but they're still alive!
say:5:1611115004:0.female: Amazing... They've been sealed away for so long, but they're still alive!

say:6:1611115006:0.text: What an ingenious approach... your magical mastery is truly beyond compare.
say:6:1611115006:0.source_cn: 如此独特的思维方式和高深的魔法造诣……看来我要学习的还...
say:6:1611115006:0.male: What an ingenious approach... your magical mastery is truly beyond compare.
say:6:1611115006:0.female: What an ingenious approach... your magical mastery is truly beyond compare.

say:7:1611115007:0.text: Still... isn't that a bit dangerous? If we're checking each Memory Star one by one, some might break free...
say:7:1611115007:0.source_cn: 不过，我总觉得这样会很危险。我们要逐个检查这些记忆之星...
say:7:1611115007:0.male: Still... isn't that a bit dangerous? If we're checking each Memory Star one by one, some might break free...
say:7:1611115007:0.female: Still... isn't that a bit dangerous? If we're checking each Memory Star one by one, some might break free...

say:8:1611115008:0.text: Then we'd better stay ready for a fight.
say:8:1611115008:0.source_cn: 我们得时刻做好战斗准备。
say:8:1611115008:0.male: Then we'd better stay ready for a fight.
say:8:1611115008:0.female: Then we'd better stay ready for a fight.
